if: the goods or services or both are ones ON WHICH TAX HAS BEEN PAID UNDER SECTION 10, the composition levy
then: input tax credit is NOT AVAILABLE on them
note: Consistent with s.2(62), which already excludes composition tax from the meaning of 'input tax'. Two provisions reach the same result by different routes, so a purchase from a composition dealer fails twice over. Section 17(5) opens 'Notwithstanding anything contained in sub-section (1) of section 16 and sub-section (1) of section 18', so this block defeats both the s.16(1) entitlement and the s.18(1) special-circumstances credit. Business use does not cure it. The source is the CGST Act as updated 31-08-2021. UNKNOWN whether a later amendment has changed this clause; later amendments are not held locally.
